Select compounds tested against human Prostaglandin G/H synthase 1 with exact IC50 values. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then docs, then target_dictionary. Filter by target name 'Prostaglandin G/H synthase 1' and target organism Homo sapiens. Filter for standard_type IC50 and exact measurements (standard_relation = '='). Include raw activity columns standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Cast activity_comment to NULL if it contains non-integer strings like 'Not Active'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all qualifying activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
